reaction: The two poses make the need for opposing pulls clear and satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the straightening muscles was most worthwhile because it completed the arm and showed why movement in both directions needs opposing pulls.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding joint fluid was clear, but as another sole offered combination it involved little decision-making.

surprise.text: I was surprised that joint fluid also helps nourish cartilage, which has no blood vessels of its own.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each part a clear purpose, although most steps offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because assembling the arm made the relationship between joint structures and muscle movement clear, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
